description: Maximum project cost for manufacturing micro units is Rs 50 Lakhs.
PMEGP first loan is strictly for greenfield (new) enterprise creation.
Applicant must be minimum 18 years of age.
Eligible sectors are non-farm manufacturing and service activities.
PMFME individual enterprise maximum supported capital size.
Must be food processing or agri-produce value addition.
AHIDF minimum project size for commercial chilling/processing plants is Rs 10 Lakhs.
Enterprise must focus on dairy processing, chilling, or feed manufacturing.
Mudra Tarun / Tarun Plus maximum financing is Rs 20 Lakhs.
Tarun category starts above Rs 5 Lakhs.
